title: Studentski Centar are the 2020/21 ABA League 2 Champion
description: Spars prevailed in Game 2, but Studentski centar have claimed the championship title as they won the 2021 ABA League 2 Finals on aggregate 170:161. What a success for Studentski centar! In their first ever season in ABA League 2, the Podgorica side has won the championship title! Studentski centar have defeated Spars in the 2021 ABA League Finals and have therefore secured their place in the 2021/22 ABA League 1 season. On the other side, Spars will have one more chance to reach the ABA League 1 as they will play against Split in the Promotion/Relegation Playoffs. The winner of that best-of-3 series will qualify for the 2021/22 ABA League 1 season. After winning Game 1 by 99:89, Studentski centar made a great start in Game 2, taking an 8-point lead in the opening quarter 21:13. The Podgorica troops have had the lead throughout most of the game, but Spars then made a stunning 4th quarter…
imageCaption: SC Derby Podgorica conquer ABA League trophy
